captions.detailed: This 3D model features a binocular astronomy instrument composed of two parallel refractor tubes mounted on a single-arm yoke. The optical tubes are finished in a light beige/cream color with dark grey lens caps, eyepieces, and mounting rings, while the structural cradle, yoke, and tripod are a dark charcoal grey. The instrument is designed with two degrees of freedom: a continuous azimuth rotation where the yoke base connects to the tripod head, and a revolute altitude joint connecting the horizontal cradle to the vertical yoke arm.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a binocular astronomy instrument. It should feature two parallel beige refractor tubes with dark lenses and eyepieces, secured to a dark grey horizontal cradle. The cradle must connect via a revolute altitude joint to a single-arm yoke, which in turn rotates on a continuous azimuth joint atop a slender black tripod base.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using cylinders for the central shaft and swept or curved extrusions for the three legs. Model the azimuth bearing using concentric cylinders. Build the single-arm yoke using a combination of box primitives for the horizontal offset and the vertical arm. Create the altitude joint with a cylindrical pin and a adjustment knob. Finally, construct the binocular assembly by placing two parallel cylinders with stepped radii for the optical tubes, capping them with dark lenses, and mounting them on a flat horizontal plate.
